document_structure.content:
Template ID | FIN-IOU-001
Category | Promissory notes & IOUs
Intended use | Evidence of an existing debt; use a promissory note where a formal payment promise or negotiable instrument is intended.

DRAFTING PLACEHOLDERS: Replace every {{...}} field, delete unused options, complete all schedules, and resolve all [SELECT]/[OPTIONAL] text before signature. Text in square brackets is an instruction, not an agreed term.
This ACKNOWLEDGEMENT OF DEBT (IOU) (the “Agreement”) is made on {EFFECTIVE_DATE} (the “Effective Date”) by and between {{PARTY_A_LEGAL_NAME}} and {{PARTY_B_LEGAL_NAME}}.
Each may be referred to as a “Party” and together as the “Parties”. The legal names, entity types, registration details and notice addresses of the Parties are set out below.

content.content:
Party A | {{PARTY_A_LEGAL_NAME}}; {{ENTITY_TYPE}}; registration no. {{REGISTRATION_NUMBER}}; address {{REGISTERED_ADDRESS}}; email {{NOTICE_EMAIL}}
Party B | {{PARTY_B_LEGAL_NAME}}; {{ENTITY_TYPE}}; registration no. {{REGISTRATION_NUMBER}}; address {{REGISTERED_ADDRESS}}; email {{NOTICE_EMAIL}}

document_structure.heading: BACKGROUND
content: A. The Parties wish to enter into the financial arrangement described in this Agreement.
B. Each Party confirms that it has authority to enter into and perform this Agreement, subject to the terms below.

document_structure.heading: 1. ACKNOWLEDGEMENT
content: The Debtor acknowledges that, as of {{ACKNOWLEDGEMENT_DATE}}, the Debtor owes the Creditor {{CURRENCY}} {{DEBT_AMOUNT}} (the “Debt”) arising from {{BASIS_OF_DEBT}}. The Debtor confirms that the amount stated is {{ADMITTED_IN_FULL / SUBJECT_TO_THE_RECONCILIATION_IN_SCHEDULE_A}}.

document_structure.heading: 2. PAYMENT OBLIGATION
content: The Debtor shall pay the Debt to the Creditor by {{PAYMENT_METHOD}} no later than {{DUE_DATE}}, or in the instalments set out in Schedule A.

document_structure.heading: 3. INTEREST
content: The Debt shall {{BEAR / NOT BEAR}} interest. If interest applies, the rate is {{RATE}} per annum from {{START_DATE}}, subject to applicable law.

document_structure.heading: 4. NO NOVATION UNLESS STATED
content: This acknowledgement records the Debt and does not, by itself, release, replace or novate any underlying obligation or security unless the Parties expressly state otherwise in writing.

document_structure.heading: 5. DISPUTED AMOUNTS
content: Any dispute concerning the calculation or basis of the Debt must be notified in writing within {{DAYS}} days with reasonable particulars. Undisputed amounts remain payable when due, subject to mandatory law.

document_structure.heading: 6. RECORDS AND RECEIPTS
content: Creditor shall provide a receipt for each payment and, after full settlement, written confirmation that the Debt recorded in this IOU has been paid in full.

document_structure.heading: 7. GOVERNING LAW
content: This IOU is governed by {{GOVERNING_JURISDICTION}} and subject to the dispute forum stated in {{COURT_OR_ARBITRATION_VENUE}}.

document_structure.heading: SIGNATURES
content: The Parties have caused this Agreement to be executed by their duly authorised representatives as of the dates set out below.

content.content:
DEBTOR |  | By: ______________________________ | Name: {SIGNATORY_NAME} | Title: {SIGNATORY_TITLE} | Date: {SIGNATURE_DATE} | Witness (if required): __________________ | Name: {{WITNESS_NAME}} | Date: {{WITNESS_DATE}}
CREDITOR |  | By: ______________________________ | Name: {SIGNATORY_NAME} | Title: {SIGNATORY_TITLE} | Date: {SIGNATURE_DATE} | Witness (if required): __________________ | Name: {{WITNESS_NAME}} | Date: {{WITNESS_DATE}}
